evidence.detail: Second remove_pd regex r'(^| )[\[({]?pd ?-?[])}]?' matches '[PD ' in '[PD '32]', strips it, leaving "'32] Izzet Twin (Alt )"
remove_season with season_id=32 matches '32]' via r'(?:[\[({]|\b)32(?:[])}]|\b)' and removes it, leaving leading "'" in name
test_remove_pd has no test case for [PD '32] format with apostrophe-prefixed season number, confirming the case is unhandled

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/deck_name.py, add a regex to remove_pd() before the existing generic second pattern to handle the apostrophe-season format: `name = re.sub(r"(^| )[\[({]?pd ?'\d+[])}]?([ -]|$)", '\\1\\2', name, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()`. Add a test in decksite/deck_name_test.py for `remove_pd("[PD '32] Izzet Twin (alt.)", 32) == "Izzet Twin (alt.)"`. ~5 lines changed.
triage.notes: The ordering of remove_pd before remove_brackets is the root enabler; the generic second pattern in remove_pd is too greedy. Fixing in remove_pd is cleaner than reordering the calls.
